title: animated settings
description: ~/.config/hyprpeach/animated.json (under $XDG_CONFIG_HOME when that is set). `hyprpeach scene` and `hyprpeach speed` write it, and it can be edited by hand; the running renderer looks at it once a second either way. A key left out takes the default here. The renderer and the CLI both read their choices and defaults from this file, so this is the only list of them.

$schema.description: Where this schema is, for an editor to check the file against. Written by the CLI; not read by the renderer.

scene.description: Which world the nine desktops are places in. One file each in renderer/src/scenes/, and the renderer's tests hold this list to those files.

speed.description: How long a desktop switch takes, whatever the distance -- 2 -> 8 takes as long as 2 -> 3, covering more ground. calm: 1.6 s, the first release's pace, for watching it. quick: 0.8 s. snappy: 0.45 s, for when the switch is in the way of the work.
